connector.name: Vivado MCP Native
connector.registryDescription: Native MCP server for controlling AMD/Xilinx Vivado on Windows and Linux via persistent Tcl.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package vivado-mcp-native. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the arthurzxy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: VIVADO_MCP_OUTPUT_ENCODING
env.description: Optional Vivado Tcl console output encoding, such as utf-8 or gbk.
